CommunityApplications.Profile:
Wolfenstein 3-D, from the source id Software released in 1995, ported to 64-bit Linux and played in a browser. The container brings its own X server and exports it over noVNC - nothing is needed on the host.
The AdLib music and effects and the Sound Blaster's voices come out of the browser, over the same port as the picture, with nothing to set up. The shareware episode is included, so it plays as soon as it starts; your own copy of the game takes precedence when you add one. The registered game is not included and comes from your own copy.
Issues and questions go to the GitHub tracker linked below.
